battle.name: 隋平李光仕叛亂
battle.theater: 處州西平郡山地（今浙江麗水）
battle.brief: 開皇十七年（597），江南處州李光仕聚眾起兵，據守州郡城寨與浙南山道，斷絕漕運。隋文帝遣大將率師南下，斷其糧道、逼其出城，於山道間合圍殲滅，數月而平，叛地隨即編戶置縣。卡面的羅馬弩砲是扭力儲能的單發箭砲，並不在浙南山道上；隋軍攻城所恃者為架床弩、投石機與巢車、撞車一類器械。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場衝突是隋開皇十七年（597）隋廷在江南平定的一場地方叛亂，交戰的兩端，一端是隋朝中央政府，另一端是以李光仕為首的江南地方豪族與陳朝舊部勢力。隋方由開皇帝楊堅下詔，遣上柱國、尚書令級別的大將出任行軍總管，兵分數路自北方與長江中游南下；主力是隋朝在江南新置州縣的州郡兵、府兵與募兵，攻城時還能調集平陳時所獲的陳朝降將與舟師，糧秣則由江淮運河與長江水路北運南下。指揮系統是隋朝典型的軍府制：行軍總管統軍，行軍長史掌軍籍與文案，司馬掌兵，兵曹與參軍分曹理事，各路總管之下設軍府與若干州縣，州刺史與縣令就地供兵供糧。叛方則是靠山區地形與鄉里宗族起家的一方，兵員多為本地鄉兵、獵戶與陳朝遺下的舊部，人數有限而地利可恃，據守州郡城與山寨，斷絕漕運、劫掠倉場，把隋朝在江南的政令與新置的州縣體系一併打亂。兩相比較，隋方勝在編制完整、可以持久用兵，叛方勝在熟悉山川、出沒無常。
countriesEn: This clash was a local rising put down by the Sui court in Jiangnan in Kaihuang 17 (597). One side was the central government of the Sui dynasty; the other was a league of Jiangnan landholders and former Chen court followers led by Li Guangshi. The Sui side acted on an edict of the Kaihuang emperor, Yang Jian, and sent a general of the rank of shangzhuguo and Shangshu ling to serve as xingjun zongguan, with columns moving south by several routes from the north and from the middle Yangtze. The main body consisted of the troops of the newly established Jiangnan prefectures and counties, of the fubing, and of recruited soldiers; for the sieges the court could call on Chen officers who had surrendered and on its river fleet, and grain was moved south along the Jianghuai canal and the Yangtze. The command system was the usual Sui military-office system: a xingjun zongguan in overall command, a xingjun zhangshi in charge of the rolls and the paperwork, a sima over the troops, with bingcao and canjun handling their own departments; under each column stood a military office and a number of prefectures and counties, whose governors and magistrates supplied men and grain on the spot. The rebels were the opposite arrangement: men raised from the local clans and villages of the hills, hunters and survivors of the old Chen army, few in number but at home in the ground, holding the prefectural cities and the hill forts, cutting the grain traffic, raiding the depots, and so breaking up both the Sui edicts and the newly drawn prefectural system in Jiangnan. The comparison is plain enough: the Sui side had the complete organisation to sustain a long campaign; the rebels had the advantage of knowing the mountains and of moving unseen.
people: 留下姓名的，主要有叛方領袖李光仕與隋方最高決策者開皇帝楊堅。李光仕的生平記載極少，只能確定他是開皇十七年江南起兵的策動者：曾據州郡城與山區城堡，遣使四鄰州縣，聲勢一度牽動東南。隋文帝楊堅自開皇元年受禪到開皇二十年退位，開皇年間他以「若有一事不當，必暴露之」自警，每一次江南用兵都由他下詔、定方略、命將；本役的具體經過，《隋書》與《資治通鑑》都只以寥寥數語帶過，領兵大將的姓名在流傳文字中已經失考，只能從同類事件推知：隋朝在江南的每一次平亂，向例由尚書令、上柱國楊素統兵。楊素自平陳之後屢平江南豪族，開皇十年至十一年間先後平高智慧、汪文進、沈君諷等部，經驗與部下皆最為老到，開皇十七年他仍是尚書令與上柱國，由他或其薦將出兵的機會最大。同一年，漢王楊諒在并州舉兵反隋，隋文帝另遣上柱國宇文述率軍討平，可見當時用兵之頻。皇太子楊廣與蜀王楊秀等宗室子弟亦先後在軍中歷事；江南陳朝舊臣與地方豪族，則在高智慧、汪文進、沈君諷與後來的李英林、李佛子一連串事件中反覆現身。將領姓名失考，並不表示無人可用，而表示這類地方叛亂在隋朝正史上被壓縮成了一行字。
peopleEn: Very few names survive. On the rebel side there is Li Guangshi himself, whose biography is almost wholly lost: all that can be established is that he set the rising going in Jiangnan in Kaihuang 17, held prefectural cities and hill forts, sent emissaries to the neighbouring prefectures and counties, and for a time drew the whole of the south-east into the business. On the Sui side the decisions belonged to the Kaihuang emperor, Yang Jian, who reigned from his accession in 581 to his retirement in 600, and who described himself as a man who, if a single thing were mishandled, would let it be exposed; every Jiangnan campaign of his reign began with his edict, and the plan and the choice of commanders were his. The detailed course of this particular operation survives only as a few words in the Suishu and in the Zizhi Tongjian, and the name of the general in the field has been lost in transmission; one can only infer it from comparable cases, for every time the Sui put down a rising in Jiangnan the column was led by the Shangshu ling and shangzhuguo Yang Su. Yang Su had broken more than one such rising after the conquest of Chen, taking the bands of Gao Zhihui, Wang Wenjin and Shen Junfeng in the years Kaihuang 10 and 11, and in Kaihuang 17 he was still shangzhuguo and Shangshu ling, so the odds are that the army sent against Li Guangshi was his, or a commander's he chose. In the same year the Han prince Yang Liang rose in Bingzhou, and the court sent the shangzhuguo Yuwen Shu against him; the frequency of such mobilisations is itself a kind of evidence. The crown prince Yang Guang and other princes of the house had already seen service; the former Chen courtiers and Jiangnan landholders reappear in one long series of risings, from Gao Zhihui and Wang Wenjin to Shen Junfeng, and later to Li Yinglin and Li Fozi. That the name of the commander is missing does not mean there was nobody to lead; it means that in the official history of the Sui this sort of local rising was compressed into a single line.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲（scorpio），是扭力儲能的單發箭砲，一發一具箭，以絞盤拉緊的纖維束蓄力，弩矢長逾一公尺，鋼矢可穿重甲，有效射程一般被估在數百步；在第二次布匿戰爭與希臘化諸城攻防中，羅馬人用它拆城牆、壓塔樓，終於拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。但這樣的兵器在開皇十七年的江南並不存在，也不會出現在浙南的山道上。與它功能相當、真正在隋軍攻城序列中出現的，是弩砲一類的架床弩與投石機：隋軍所用的弩以木臂加機關，裝於低車或高台之上，人數多者稱「床子弩」，可連續發射以壓制城頭；石砲則以木架配皮兜繩索，拋擲石彈攻擊城牆與塔樓。除投射火力外，隋軍攻城還靠巢車、雲梯、撞車與飛樓一類可移動的攻城塔具與撞擊器械，渡水用五牙大艦與平底船隻，糧秣以江船北運。步兵裝備是鐵矛長槊、環首刀與弓箭，護具為兜鍪、鎧甲與漆盾；騎兵在江南水網地帶運用有限，主要靠步卒與舟師。叛方裝備更具地方色彩：竹木為盾、稻稈為甲，長槊、柴刀與弓弩為主，並以熟悉的山道、水渡與城巖作屏障，缺少女真一類的攻城器械。這場戰爭在裝備史上的意義，不在某一種武器，而在隋朝以「弩砲壓城、撞車近城、步卒登城」這套組合，把山區城寨變成可攻取、可占守的目標。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman scorpio, a torsion-powered bolt-thrower that looses a single heavy bolt and stores its energy in twisted skeins of fibre. Its bolts run to more than a metre, its steel points will go through heavy armour, and its effective range is generally put at several hundred paces. In the Second Punic War and in the sieges of the Hellenistic cities the Romans used it against walls and towers, and so they took down the Greek city-state system. Nothing of the kind existed in Jiangnan in Kaihuang 17, and nothing of the kind would be seen on a mountain track in southern Zhejiang. What stood in its place in the Sui siege order was the family of bed-mounted crossbows and stone-throwers. The Sui crossbow had a wooden stock and a trigger mechanism, was mounted on a low cart or on a raised platform, and in its larger forms, the chuangzi nu of four, five or seven beds, could fire continuously against the parapet; the stone-thrower was a timber frame with a hide sling and rope, hurling stone shot against walls and towers. Beside the artillery stood the mobile siege works, the nest-cart, the scaling ladder, the battering ram and the flying tower, and the river crossings were made in five-toothed great ships and flat-bottomed boats, with grain coming down by river craft. The foot soldier carried the iron spear and long glaive, the ring-pommel sabre and the bow, and wore a helmet, armour and a lacquered shield; cavalry had little use in a land cut by water, so the army leaned on foot and flotilla. The rebels were far more local in their gear: shields of bamboo and wood, armour of rice straw, long glaives, billhooks and bows, and they used their knowledge of the tracks, the fords and the cliffs as their real defence, for they had no artillery of their own. The significance of this war in the history of arms lies in no single weapon but in the Sui combination of crossbow battery, battering ram against the wall and footmen over the top, by which a hilltop stronghold could be made into a thing that could be stormed and then held.
tactics: 隋朝平定江南叛亂有一套成熟的辦法，可以從這類戰役的過程看出。第一步是詔令與封鎖：兵到之前，先下詔宣布首惡與脅從的區別，命各州縣加固城防、斷絕與叛軍的交通往來，州郡兵守土，府兵與募兵據守要道與渡口，斷其糧道與外援。第二步是壓制與進逼：隋軍一般不急於強攻，而先以弩砲、弓弩在遠處封住城門與通道，逼迫叛軍離開城寨與山險，同時分兵佔領其後方州縣，切斷退往鄰州的可能。第三步是合圍殲滅：叛軍一旦離開既有的地利，便在隋軍預設的路口、平原或水邊被截住，此時以長槊壓前、弓弩齊發，步卒與騎兵截斷退路完成包圍，多數戰鬥在接觸後不久便告結束。第四步是收束：平叛之後，隋廷把首惡押送京師論罪，把被裹脅的鄉民遣回本籍，給糧散歸，並在叛亂之地重新編戶置縣、整飭州縣官吏。隋朝沒有成文的野戰條例，這套「斷其路、逼其出、殲於野、編其戶」的辦法，實際上比攻城器械的規模更決定戰役的成敗。
tacticsEn: The Sui had a settled method for putting down a rising in Jiangnan, and the course of this kind of operation shows it. The first stage was the edict and the blockade. Before the troops arrived, the court announced the distinction between the leaders of the revolt and those carried along with it, ordered the prefectures and counties to strengthen their walls, and cut the traffic with the rebels; the local militia held the cities, the fubing and the recruited soldiers held the roads and the fords, and the rebels' supplies and outside help were cut off. The second stage was pressure and the closing of the ring. The Sui army did not hurry to assault; it began by sealing the gates and the passages from a distance with crossbows and artillery, forcing the rebels out of their cities and their strong ground, while detached columns took the prefectures and counties behind them and removed any possibility of a retreat towards the neighbouring districts. The third stage was the annihilation. Once the rebels had been dragged off the ground they knew, they were intercepted at a road, on the plain or by the water where the Sui had set up to meet them, and there the army closed the ring with glaives in front, a simultaneous release of arrows, and foot or cavalry cutting the road behind; most such engagements were over shortly after contact. The fourth stage was the settlement. After the rising was broken, the leading men were taken to the capital to be tried, the villagers who had been carried along were given grain and sent home, and the districts concerned were put under a fresh household register, with counties re-established and officials reorganised. The Sui had no written field manual, and in the end the method of cutting the road, dragging the enemy out, destroying them in the open and re-registering the households mattered more to the outcome than the size of the siege works.
data: 可核對的數字不多，本役的文獻尤其簡略，須把確定與推想分開。確定者：年份為開皇十七年，即公元597年，干支丁巳；時值隋文帝在位中期，隋朝平陳已過八年（陳於開皇九年即589年亡國），《開皇律》頒於開皇十三年，大索貌閱行於開皇九年，江南州縣在開皇年間經過一次大規模改置，處州開皇三年置，婺州開皇九年置。同期用兵密度可作旁證：開皇十年至十一年間，隋廷先後平定高智慧、汪文進、沈君諷等江南起兵，開皇十七年又平李光仕，同年漢王楊諒在并州反，開皇十八年再議高句麗。不可考者：本役的兵員數、攻城日數、斬首與俘虜之數、糧秣消耗，《隋書》與《資治通鑑》都沒有留下；傳世文字只以「江南李光仕作亂，隋兵討平之」一類的句子帶過，起事的具體月日亦已失考，本篇依開皇年間江南用兵多在夏秋的常例，將用兵置於同年秋初。規模上的參照：隋軍在平陳之役曾以八路大軍同時進取，兵力在五十萬上下，那是傾國而出的大會戰，與此種地方叛亂不可同日而語；此類叛亂通常只以數千至數萬的州郡兵與募兵對付。戰役的地理範圍亦只能大致圈定在處州西平郡所在的浙南山地，以及它與婺州、睦州相接的山道與水渡一線。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are few, and the record of this operation is unusually thin, so it is worth separating what is certain from what is inferred. Certain: the year was Kaihuang 17, that is 597 CE, the ding-si year; the Sui was in the middle of the Kaihuang era, eight years after the fall of Chen, which came in Kaihuang 9, 589; the Kaihuang Code was promulgated in Kaihuang 13; the great registration of the people was carried out in Kaihuang 9; and the prefectures and counties of Jiangnan were redrawn more than once during the Kaihuang years, Chuzhou among them, established in Kaihuang 3, and Wuzhou, established in Kaihuang 9. The density of the fighting in the same period serves as a side witness: between Kaihuang 10 and 11 the court put down the risings of Gao Zhihui, Wang Wenjin and Shen Junfeng in Jiangnan; in Kaihuang 17 it put down Li Guangshi; in the same year the Han prince Yang Liang rose in Bingzhou; and in Kaihuang 18 the question of Koguryo was taken up again. Not recoverable: the strength of the armies, the number of days of the siege, the counts of heads and captives, and the consumption of grain are all absent from both the Suishu and the Zizhi Tongjian. The transmitted text carries the affair in a single clause, to the effect that Li Guangshi rose in Jiangnan and the Sui troops put him down, and the exact month has been lost, so this account places the campaigning in the early autumn of that year, following the common pattern of Jiangnan operations. As a measure of scale: in the conquest of Chen the Sui moved eight great columns at once with something like five hundred thousand men, but that was a national conscription for a set-piece campaign and cannot be compared with a local rising of this kind, which was normally met with a few thousand or some tens of thousands of militia and recruited men. The geographical scope of the operation can only be roughly bounded: the hills of Chuzhou and its Xiping commandery in southern Zhejiang, together with the tracks and fords that link them to Wuzhou and Muzhou.
cause: 要看懂李光仕之亂，須把視線放回開皇年間隋朝對江南的整頓。第一層是制度上的收緊：陳朝亡國之後，隋朝在江南廢陳之制、置新州、定租調、括隱戶，把前朝依附於豪族與寺院的戶口重新編入州縣簿籍，大索貌閱與租調的恢復都使江南的既得利益者受損。第二層是宗教財產的剝奪：開皇九、十年之間，隋文帝下詔沙門、道士並令還俗，寺觀田產入官，江南是佛教最盛之地，這道詔令對南方的打擊尤其直接。第三層是役政與軍事的抽取：開皇十三年起屢攻高句麗，役夫、轉運與軍糧的徵發由江南承擔最重，州縣的倉庫與民車都被調往北方。第四層是地方社會的結構：陳朝舊臣與南方的門第豪族在改朝換代之後失去原有的政治位置，民間又有朝廷只知向東北用兵而不知江南生計的怨言，於是一有豪族首倡，山澤之間的鄉兵與舊部便聞風響應。因此李光仕的反亂並非單純的盜匪，而是把上述不滿匯聚成的地方叛變；隋廷的反應也正因如此，重在穩定州縣與戶籍，而不只是追求斬首之數。
causeEn: To understand the rising of Li Guangshi one has to look at the tightening up of Jiangnan under the Sui during the Kaihuang years. The first layer is administrative. After the fall of Chen the court abolished the Chen institutions, created new prefectures, fixed the land tax and the silk tax, and drew the households hidden under the great families and under the monasteries back into the registers; the great registration and the restoration of the taxes both took from the Jiangnan interest groups what they had held. The second layer is the taking of religious property. Between Kaihuang 9 and 10 the court ordered the Buddhist monks and the Daoist clergy to return to lay life, and the fields and buildings of the temples and the monasteries passed into the treasury; southern China was the most heavily Buddhist region of the empire, and this edict fell upon it with particular force. The third layer is the extraction of labour and of men for the war. From Kaihuang 13 onwards the court went at Koguryo again and again, and the corvée, the transport and the military grain were drawn from Jiangnan more heavily than from anywhere else, with the depots and the carts of the prefectures sent north. The fourth layer is the structure of local society. The former Chen courtiers and the old great families of the south had lost their political position with the change of dynasty, and among the people there was a standing resentment that the court could send armies to the north-east while taking no heed of the livelihood of the south; so that once a landholder gave the word, the village levies and the old soldiers of the hills and streams answered the call. The rising of Li Guangshi was therefore not plain banditry but a local insurrection in which those grievances came together, and the Sui response was shaped accordingly: the point was to steady the prefectures and the registers, not merely to gather up a tally of heads.
impact: 這場叛亂的直接結果不大，深遠的影響卻可以沿著兩條線看。第一條線是國家對江南的編制。隋朝平陳之後，江南一直是財政與兵源上的關鍵，歷次平亂之後，州縣改置、編戶齊民、寺觀田產入官、餘勇散歸州里這幾件事被反覆做了一遍，隋朝在南方的統治因此由軍事征服變成日常治理；大業年間江南仍能供應府兵、糧食與船隻，支撐起征高句麗與平定楊廣死後的亂事。第二條線是矛盾的積累。租調與徭役在開皇末年已開始加重，開皇十八年以後又再議役制，江南的鄉里既要出錢出粟，又要出丁出車，開皇年間被壓下去的起兵苗頭並未真正消失；到大業年間，江南第一次大規模起事，張金稱、劉元進、宋子賢、杜伏威、郝孝德一類人物相繼起事，幾乎都出在同一片水鄉與山區，說明李光仕這一役之後，地方社會的怨氣只是被壓住而未消失。第三，軍事技術上，這類戰役把隋朝以弩砲、撞車、巢車攻山區城寨的辦法推到實戰裡，經驗隨後流入大業年征高句麗時在遼東修城築壘的作法之中。第四，同期漢王楊諒被平、楊素等重臣相繼去世或失勢，使隋文帝晚年的猜忌加深，開皇末年的朝廷氣氛為其後的宮廷變亂埋下伏線。
impactEn: The immediate result was small, but the consequences can be followed along two lines. The first is the state's organisation of Jiangnan. After the conquest of Chen, Jiangnan remained the hinge of the treasury and of the recruitment of soldiers, and after each pacification the same work was done over again: the prefectures redrawn, the households registered on a single footing, the temple lands taken into the treasury, the surplus fighting men dispersed back into the local militia. Sui rule in the south thus passed from military conquest into ordinary administration, and Jiangnan could still supply fubing, grain and shipping in the Daye years, on which the campaigns against Koguryo and the suppression of the trouble after Yang Guang's death were sustained. The second line is the accumulation of grievance. The land tax and the corvée grew heavier towards the end of Kaihuang, and the labour regulations were revised again after Kaihuang 18; the villages of the south had to furnish money and grain and men and carts at once, and the sparks of revolt suppressed during the Kaihuang years had not really gone out. By the Daye era the first great risings in the south, men like Zhang Jincheng, Liu Yuanjin, Song Zixian, Du Fuwei and Hao Xiaode taking turns, broke out almost in the same watery country and hills, which shows that after the rising of Li Guangshi the anger of local society was suppressed rather than removed. Third, in military terms, an operation of this kind put the Sui practice of using crossbow batteries, battering rams and nest-carts against hilltop strongholds to the test in earnest, and that experience ran on into the building of ramps and platforms before Liao-dong in the later campaigns against Koguryo. Fourth, the defeat of the prince Yang Liang in the same year and the death or eclipse of ministers such as Yang Su deepened the suspicion of the ageing Kaihuang emperor, and the atmosphere at court in the last years of the era prepared the ground for the palace disorders of the following decade.
result: 開皇十七年，隋軍平定了李光仕在江南的起兵：叛軍失去城寨與山道的依託，被逐出所據的州郡，戰事在數月之內收束，首惡被押解京師論罪，脅從的鄉民由官府給糧遣返本籍，叛亂地區重新編戶置縣，州縣官吏也隨之整飭。李光仕本人的下落，傳世史文沒有留下確切記載，僅能確定的是這場叛亂沒有發展成跨州的割據，也沒有與同年并州的漢王楊諒之亂相互呼應，江南的州縣秩序在隋朝控制下得以恢復。從更大的局面看，這一役是隋文帝開皇年間平定江南豪族政策的最後幾次執行之一：隋朝沒有在江南留下常駐重兵，而是以州郡兵守土、以編戶制取財、以罰治首惡的方式維持秩序；這套政策延續到隋煬帝時，江南的社會矛盾卻同時在累積，大業末年那場席捲江淮的起兵浪潮，正是這些年累積下來的結果。所以這場戰爭在戰史上只是一行字，在制度史上卻是一次不大不小的檢驗：它證明剛剛建立的隋朝有能力迅速平定地方叛亂，也顯示它平亂的方式留下了怎樣的後果。
resultEn: In Kaihuang 17 the Sui army ended the rising of Li Guangshi in Jiangnan. The rebels lost their cities and their strong ground in the hills, were driven out of the prefectures they had held, and the fighting was closed within a few months; the leaders were taken to the capital to be tried, the villagers carried along with them were given grain and sent home, the districts affected were put under a fresh register, and the officials of the counties were reorganised. The later fate of Li Guangshi himself is not recorded with certainty. All that can be established is that the rising never grew into a rebellion spanning several prefectures and never answered the revolt of the Han prince Yang Liang in Bingzhou in the same year, and that the prefectural order in Jiangnan was restored under Sui control. In the larger picture this was one of the last executions of the Kaihuang policy of putting down the great families of Jiangnan. The Sui did not leave a heavy garrison in the south; it kept the districts with their own militia, drew its revenue from the household register, and maintained order by punishing the leaders, and that policy ran on into the reign of the Yangdi emperor, where at the same time the social contradictions of the south went on piling up, so that the wave of risings that swept the Jianghuai in the last years of the dynasty was the sum of the years of accumulation. This war is therefore a single line in the narrative of battles and a small but real test in the narrative of institutions: it showed that the newly founded Sui could put down a local rebellion quickly, and it showed what consequences its way of putting down rebellions left behind.
